1.web: Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh, all the earth.
1.asv: Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song: Sing unto Jehovah, all the earth.

2.web: Sing to Yahweh! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!
2.asv: Sing unto Jehovah, bless his name; Show forth his salvation from day to day.

3.web: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
3.asv: Declare his glory among the nations, His marvellous works among all the peoples.

4.web: For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.
4.asv: For great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised: He is to be feared above all gods.

5.web: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.
5.asv: For all the gods of the peoples are idols; But Jehovah made the heavens.

6.web: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
6.asv: Honor and majesty are before him: Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

7.web: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of nations, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.
7.asv: Ascribe unto Jehovah, ye kindreds of the peoples, Ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength.

8.web: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
8.asv: Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due unto his name: Bring an offering, and come into his courts.

9.web: Worship Yahweh in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.
9.asv: Oh worship Jehovah in holy array: Tremble before him, all the earth.

10.web: Say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.
10.asv: Say among the nations, Jehovah reigneth: The world also is established that it cannot be moved: He will judge the peoples with equity.

11.web: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!
11.asv: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;

12.web: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy
12.asv: Let the field exult, and all that is therein; Then shall all the trees of the wood sing for joy

13.web: before Yahweh; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.
13.asv: Before Jehovah; for he cometh, For he cometh to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with his truth.
